protocol.cross_arm_correctness: all four cases must match input payload SHA-256 and each sink event count, length-prefixed full-stream SHA-256, and representative full envelope; harness also checks every envelope by value and exact serialized bytes
protocol.metric: median of the three inner duration_ns samples per case; paired candidate minus baseline; positive is a candidate slowdown
protocol.pair_order: alternating AB/BA across the three warmup pairs and 48 measured pairs; first measured pair is BA
